_meta.description: CHEDPP refdata. Two-grain shape: commodities (commodity_code) + species (commodity_code|eppo_code). Per-commodity flags (requires_test_and_trial, requires_finished_or_propagated, propagation) live on commodities[code]; species fields (regulatory_authority, marketing_standard, validity_period, varieties) live on species[code|eppo]. Booleans the engine consumes are computed at read time by resolvers.js — not stored. See features/journey-switching/plants-refdata-model.md and 03-gms-correction-and-scenario-coverage.md.
